rows.jyutping: laai1 dou3 sat6 jat1 sat6 gam3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something pulled or stretched very tight, such as a wire or rope.

example.english: The clothesline was pulled tautly, so it did not move even in the wind.
example.traditional: 條晾衫繩拉到實一實咁，風吹都唔郁。
example.jyutping: tiu4 long6 saam1 sing4 laai1 dou3 sat6 jat1 sat6 gam3 fung1 ceoi1 dou1 m4 juk1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on a tense, strained, or tightly stretched condition rather than simply firm holding.

example.english: The rubber band was stretched tautly and almost snapped.
example.traditional: 條橡筋繃緊咁，差啲就爆開喇。
example.jyutping: tiu4 zoeng6 gan1 bang1 gan2 gam3 caa1 di1 zau6 baau3 hoi1 laa3
